quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Toyohashi's 2026-2030 latter basic plan, rolling three-year implementation layer, FY2026 budget route, and historical FY2024 settlement route. It preserves front/latter plan versions and does not infer current achievement, fiscal causality, municipal-performance scores, or cross-city comparability.
